findings.issue: classifySourceLocation runs `if (extension === '.jsonl' || /ledger/i.test(fileName)) return classes.LEDGER_STATE;` before its repo-code fallback, so any source file whose name contains 'ledger' is classed as ledger state. That includes deep-research-ledger-schema.ts and check-ledger-stem-producers.cjs. This contradicts the declared contract in runtime/feature-catalog/coverage-graph/source-quality-class.md section 1, that the class comes 'from where the source lives' so a leaf cannot raise source diversity, and the only ledger-state fixture (upsert-script.vitest.ts:268,280) is a .jsonl state file. Reach: computeResearchSourceDiversityFromData (coverage-graph-signals.ts:674-688) counts distinct quality_class values per question, and convergence.cjs:447-451 makes sourceDiversity >= 1.5 a blocking STOP guard. Case: an honest research leaf studying this runtime cites only code, convergence.cjs and deep-research-ledger-schema.ts, and gets diversity 2. The guard passes when the true diversity is 1 and the guard should block. Before this diff the leaf supplied quality_class freely, so this is incomplete hardening of the new derivation, not a regression. It is still in reach, because the code now claims to derive the class. Fix: apply the ledger rule only to state files (.jsonl/.json, or a state/ledger artifact directory), not to every file name that contains 'ledger', and add a fixture showing that a code file named *ledger*.ts classes as repo-code.

findings.issue: Every research SOURCE node now gets a derived quality_class, including 'unclassified' when no field names a location. The diversity signal counts any non-empty class string (coverage-graph-signals.ts:680-683), so 'unclassified' counts as a distinct source kind. Case: a finding that cites one repo file and one free-text source named 'Maintainer interview' gets {repo-code, unclassified} = 2, which clears the 1.5 STOP guard. This is P2, not P1 like A2-1, because storing 'unclassified' is the declared and tested contract (source-quality-class.md section 2; upsert-script.vitest.ts:270,283). The open question is whether the signal should count it, and that is a design call the declared docs do not settle. Fix: have the diversity count skip 'unclassified', or leave quality_class unset when no location is found.

findings.issue: The new fail-closed branch that refuses a legacy 'extended' row whose extension budget has a missing or non-integer field (reason run-extended-budget-missing) has no test. append-mode-event-legacy-seam.vitest.ts covers only the happy-path upcast of a complete extended row. Case: a legacy extended row without extension.newMaxIterations is never exercised, so a regression that defaulted the ceiling instead of refusing the row would pass the suite. The lens requires a test for each changed behavior. Fix: add a seam test that sends an extended row with an incomplete extension object and asserts the refusal and its reason.
